title: Episode
description: One reel. Every time is in seconds on the voice-over (word starts from Whisper). The engine derives every frame from this file: frame = round(seconds * fps). Two formats share the file: 'cheatsheet' (cards on a grid) and 'buildup' (layers on one evolving object).

id.description: Short id, also used in the composition id (no underscores in Remotion ids).

lang.description: Language of the voice and on-screen text (captions may be in another language).

style.description: Name of the visual style/palette preset.

audio.description: Voice-over file name inside the episode's audio folder.

voDuration.description: Length of the VO in seconds.

hook.description: Opening 2-3 s. 'slam': lines[0] from the left, lines[1] from the right, impact flash, then they fly into the title. 'vs': title.line1 is split on ' vs '.

title.description: Line 2 is drawn in the accent colour with an underline sweep. 'sub' symbols '=', '+', '·' are tinted. Build-up episodes use one 'at' for the whole title.

series.description: Shows a 'PART n/of' badge for the whole video.

cards.description: Cheatsheet only. 2-6 cards, always 2 columns; an odd last card spans the full width.

n.description: Number shown on the card, as given ('07' is fine for a Part 2).

icon.description: Explainer/icon kind. The engine maps each kind to a drawer animation and a static icon.

at.description: Spoken label word: camera arrives, card lights up.

add.description: Accent line, <= 4 words. Explainer phase A starts here.

body.description: <= ~44 characters (2 lines at 40 px). Explainer phase B starts here.

layers.description: Buildup only. 5-8 layers that dock onto the hero object in order.

kind.description: Drawing kind; a set of kinds can select a drawing family.

caption.description: <= 30 chars, accent colour, under the kinetic word.

kinetic.description: Buildup: one big word at a time at the top. Each lands on its spoken word.

emphasis.description: At most 3 pop words per video. A word already visible in a panel or pill pops in place.

kind.description: allCards: pull back to the full sheet. question: a pill with a question. insight: 'what people miss' panel. cta: call to action (with 'keyword' = big comment-keyword chip). next: small 'Part 2 ->' card.

keyword.description: cta only. Long keywords shrink to fit the chip.

text2.description: cta only: the line under the chip (what they get).

logoAt.description: Wordmark draws on. Everything is still from logoAt + 1.25 s.

subs.description: Captions per spoken phrase. No overlaps. 'ar' is drawn (RTL, max 2 lines, auto-split if longer); 'en' is the source text.
